title: Infiltration
text: “That was quite a failure, but thanks to it I got summoned as Spear Hero, so all’s well that ends well, I say. A brilliant opening act, indeed.”

“What are you even talking about… I mean… I doubt anyone would suspect that Spear Hero is cross-dressing and lurking around in disguise, but won’t you stand out too much with that unfamiliar face? I think you’re going to attract way too much attention.”

“Standing out is precisely the point, I say. A gifted young lady arriving to match the new term, a woman who draws attention—pigs will burn with jealous flames and rush to harass her. I shall become fine bait for the sound, wholesome academy you desire, Itsuki, I say.”

Pigs, as a species, are base creatures who commit countless misdeeds out of jealousy toward anyone who excels, I say. The academy I transferred into was a coddled little pig farm, carefully arranged to suppress such emotions—and yet, even so, a certain number of pigs still snapped at me, I say. Ugh… memories of the defiant pigs are replaying in my mind. In any case, this is a school that housed both a sheltered piggery and that suspicious Crimson Swine, so surely a horde of pigs will come snapping at me in droves, I say.
“That almost sounds reasonable, coming from you, Motoyasu-san… except you can’t even talk to women.”
“Pig-language translation shall be entrusted to Yuki-chan, I say!”
“Entrusted, indeed!”
“Wasn’t the whole point that Yuki-san is too busy to handle translation, so I came instead of you, Motoyasu-san!? Or what, are you saying I should infiltrate and help translate too!?”
“Indeed, tonight I have entrusted it to Yuki-chan, but having her do this on a regular basis would be difficult. I do not wish to interfere with Yuki-chan’s races, I say.”
“Kunuu… it’s so frustrating being tied up with races.”
Hmm… a problem has surfaced here, since we cannot rely on Yuki-chan for this, I say. Yes! A brilliant idea has struck me just now, I say!
“Then let us have Mole accompany me!”
Mole is the one who learns swordsmanship from Ren, magic from Rival and Assistant, and sewing from me—she can do it all, I say.
“Imiya-san, here? I suppose if you asked her, she probably would agree… she’s quite the studious type, so I hear she’s picked up multiple languages.”
“The perfect candidate, I say! Especially since she can use magic properly too—after all, we’ve been teaching her well.”
Mole may not be quite Yuki-chan’s level, but she should be able to translate well enough. And in a pinch, she could help save Riska and the others from the pigs.
“Well, Imiya-san can burrow into the ground, so… I suppose you’d have to consult with Naofumi-san first, but if that’s the plan, I think you should be the one giving lessons, Motoyasu-san.”
“Itsuki, the reform you wish to pursue and the reform I wish to pursue are different things. That would defeat the whole purpose, I say.”
“…Well, you got me there. Anyway! Please stop coming here just to mess with me for no reason!”
“Stay vigilant, I say. Well then, Yuki-chan, let us return.”
“Yes, indeed! Yuki shall be waiting!”

And so, I gave Itsuki a thorough warning, I say. Then I leapt out through Itsuki’s window, returned to Yuki-chan, and we went back via portal. Apparently, because of my little nighttime visit to Itsuki’s room, there was quite the buzz afterward about a nameless, breathtakingly beautiful woman appearing on campus at night. Well, Riska returned to school the very next day, and I decided to carry out my cross-dressing campus mission as well, I say.
That night, having returned to the village, I headed to Father’s house, where Father was staying, and knocked on the door, I say. From inside, I could hear cheerful, lively voices.
“Coming!”
Father opened the door with a click, took one look at me, and fell speechless. Inside were Older Sister, Panda, the children, Big Sister, and it seemed Sakura-chan had come by today too, I say.
“Um… and you… are?”
Then Father’s gaze shifted to Yuki-chan, whom I had brought along. Well then, shall we see if this trick works on Father too?
“Ohh? What’s the matter, Motoyasu-chan?”
Oh! Older Sister saw through it in a single glance, I say. As sharp as ever with this sort of thing!
“Eh!? Is that Motoyasu-kun!?”
“Indeed, it is!”
“No, saying ‘indeed’ doesn’t explain why even your voice is high-pitched—what’s going on here? Is Yuki-chan speaking for you through some device, like Rafuemon or Filoko-chan’s gadgets?”
I switched off the microphone function and spoke in my natural voice.
“I had a Faubrey engineer make it for me, I say.”
“Ah, I-I see. That’s genuinely impressive, but…”
Alright, here we go, Motoyasu—Reliable Big Sister Strategy, engage! I stepped right up to Father, gently touched his cheek, and smiled.
“If Reliable Big Brother Motoyasu troubles you, perhaps Reliable Big Sister would suit better?”
“Um… look, why is it that you’re standing so close to me, or rather, why are you crowding into my space so much?”
Ohh, it seems the retreat is weaker with the “sister” approach than the “brother” one. The power of appearances is truly formidable, I say.
“Naturally, this is to verify Father’s preferences, I say.”
“You don’t need to say that so plainly! And wait, you’re still doing this!?”
“Ohh my.”
“Older Sister, and Panda too! What do you two make of this—?”
“Ahh?”
Panda looked at me with visible irritation.
“I’ll give you credit for the disguise, Spear Hero. But what about you, huh?”
Panda was asking Father, it seemed.
“No, no, I think I agree with Lars-chan on this one, right?”
“As for me, judging by this reaction, I’m considering adopting this approach in some other loop when offering rescue, I say.”
“Wait, if you actually do that, I feel like the me in that loop is going to genuinely awaken to something weird, so I’d really, seriously appreciate it if you didn’t…”
“This is meant for times when my true self is rejected or unable to help, I say.”
“That’s exactly why it’ll mess with the head of whichever me finds out the truth—so please, don’t!”
For some reason, the memory surfaces of the Father from the loop where I reunited with Fleon-chan, but surely that’s just my imagination!
“I shall do my best, I say.”
“So Motoyasu-chan wants to be a Reliable Big Sister too, huh.”
“I wish to be relied upon by Father, Filo-tan, and the Filolial-samas, I say.”
That is my reason for living, after all! What do you think of that?
“Please, seriously, spare me. Anyway… haa… impressive, though—you’re tall, but it’s hard to tell at a glance. What’s going on with your shoulder width?”
“Lifted and drawn inward, I say. Rather cramped, indeed.”
Something like our family’s traditional yoga, I say. A skill honed during my time infiltrating pig academies.
“Right… Motoyasu-kun, huh… so, what exactly happened?”
“Ah, yes, indeed. Actually—”
And so I explained how I had launched a surprise assault on Itsuki’s quarters.
“I fooled Itsuki completely in one shot. Surely this counts as a contribution to Itsuki’s plan, I say. Smoking out the pigs, I say. The juices are practically dripping out.”
“Motoyasu-kun, everything you do is just so over the top I can’t help but be stunned.”
Haa… for some reason, Father let out a deep sigh.
“So, then…”
“There is nothing more frustrating for Yuki than having to participate in races,” Yuki said.
“Yeah. Yuki-chan’s busy, and even if we left it to the other Filolials, I’m not sure they’d have the patience to keep up with translating, so I get it.”
“And that is where Mole makes her entrance, I say.”
“You really do keep calling Imiya-chan ‘Mole,’ don’t you. Why her though?”
“She is well-suited for translation, and since everyone has been teaching her various things, I thought this would be a good opportunity to add to her experience by bringing her along, I say.”
“Well… thinking about it from Imiya-chan’s perspective, it’s not a bad idea… and you have been teaching her a lot of things too, Motoyasu-kun. Hmm…”
“Father, this is a request from Big Sister Motoyasu, I say.”

I switched the microphone on and puffed out my chest as I made the request to Father. The pig’s seductive pose makes me want to vomit, after all. Rather, I judged that a confident “leave it to me!” attitude would be more effective on Father.
“Ahh, fine already… I got it. I’ll talk to the Rumo-species folks about it.”
And so, Father went ahead and spoke with Mole and the others on my behalf. Mole herself apparently wouldn’t be attending the academy, but she agreed to help me out, I say.
“Um… why exactly am I helping with this?”
“Mole, this too is an infiltration mission, I say.”
“Haa… even Shield Hero-sama was debating whether to enroll me…”
“Father is very kind, indeed. Learning is also good, I say.”
“I think Wyndia-chan or Gaelion-chan would know more about this sort of thing than me.”

Hmm… this response from Mole reminds me somewhat of Big Sister. I think I understand why Father finds Mole cute for resembling Big Sister. Incidentally, Big Sister is currently helping with childcare alongside Older Sister. Father was at a loss for how to react at first, but once he realized it would help Itsuki, he gave his permission. Though there was the complicated condition that rampaging was forbidden, meaning I couldn’t simply dispose of pigs on the spot.
“Now then, Mole, be sure to translate the pig-speech properly, I say. Shall we be off!”
“Y-yes.”
Clack, clack—I, in disguise, stepped into the classroom and gave my self-introduction, I say.
“Good day to you all. I am Moto Northvillage.”

Your surname really does sound like it belongs to this world when translated that way, doesn’t it. Meanwhile I’m stuck with something like “Rock Valley”… I feel like I can hear the jaded voice of Father in my mind saying something like that.
“W-wow…”
“Oink.”
“Oink.”
Fufu, the men were captivated by my disguise, while the pigs cast ugly, jealousy-soaked glares my way, indeed.
“I look forward to getting along with all of you.”

I fought the urge to tack on an “I say” at the end, holding it back with sheer willpower, indeed. Fufufu, Rival. Here, I shall rack up major points and make Itsuki declare to Father just how capable I am! Witness this and be humbled, I say! Thus began my infiltration, I say. I’ve been living a bit of a school life in disguise too, and surprisingly, it isn’t as inconvenient as one might think.
“Moto-san, you know so much about everything, and you’re so skilled at making clothes too. I really admire that.”

Mole translated more or less what the pig was saying, and since there happened to be female demi-humans mixed into the academy population, I could speak without hesitation and pull off the appearance of blending into the group, I say.
“It is not so difficult, indeed—ahem. Starting with something roomy like a poncho helps build confidence, I’d say. And for beginners, I’d recommend starting with patchwork, perhaps a pouch or two.”

As for magic class, I swiftly performed the Drifa incantation, thoroughly demonstrating my talent in practical application, and for compounding studies, I drew on past experience to whip up a stimulant potion in no time, indeed. Come break time, not only the male students but the pigs too gathered around, forming a circle around me, indeed. Before I came to this world, pigs would have dominated my field of vision, but here, I could simply associate with the male students as well, I say. After that, students from multiple classes gathered for the time allotted to Itsuki’s lecture.
“Bueeeh…”
“So this is where Itsuki-kun teaches.”
Riska and Rafuemon entered the classroom as well, I say. As for Rafuemon, apparently she’s a golem dispatched by Itsuki, tasked with guarding Riska.
“Well then, let’s begin the lesson. As I mentioned last time, I’m still new at this, so please go easy on me…”
Itsuki stood at the podium and began the lesson. I took a seat toward the back to observe how things went, I say.
“First, what should we talk about…”
“Yes.”
Here, I raised my hand, I say. Itsuki has been slow to introduce Riska as his girlfriend, after all.
“…Um, is there anyone else?”

Itsuki was clearly trying to ignore my blatantly raised hand, but he’d missed his timing, and no other students raised theirs, I say. Incidentally, apparently the student who’d persistently tried to visit Itsuki’s room on the first night ended up suspended.
“Well then, you.”
“I heard, that Bow Hero-sama, has a girlfriend—who might that be?”
“…(Ahh… I really want to shoot this Spear Hero dead right now.)”

Itsuki, with a strained smile and a throbbing vein, glared daggers at me with just his eyes. What of it? This is exactly the kind of question anyone who’s caught wind of the rumors would ask, without fail, I say. He seems to have forgotten entirely that the plan was to use Riska as bait in the first place!

“Yes. I do have someone. It’s Rishia Ivyred, who’s present here today. Due to certain circumstances, I rescued her from a dire situation and have been taking care of her since, and we’ve grown close. Beside her is Rafuemon, a special golem who cooperates with us in various ways. Everyone, please make sure not to be rude to either of them.”

The classroom stirred into a buzz of murmurs. From there, the second part of Itsuki’s lecture proceeded, answering questions from other faculty members along the way. Itsuki’s lesson concluded without any particular issues, indeed. Now then, the question is what happens next. Itsuki will presumably be keeping watch over Riska. …Well, in any case, here and there, I did manage to confirm a few instances of the pigs’ own peculiar brand of jealous harassment, indeed.
